nodes.label: B-093: B-092 Execution Record Review — Four Graph Properties, Not One
nodes.description: Lane B independent review of Lane A's appended B-092 steps 6-7 graph-sync record. Read the entry header for current lifecycle status. It accepted head equality, document coverage, frag132 parity and six-node connectivity, and rejected the record as complete for two reasons: a verification anchor cannot cover text appended after it, so B-092's whole entry takes its weakest child disposition under D-204; and a green consistency suite tests neither semantic descriptions nor whole curated-layer parity. It ordered the response parent-first - P0 lifecycle correction, P1 descriptions, P2 fragment repair, P3 one final synchronization after the last tracked commit. The Judge later narrowed P1 to documentation nodes, because every blank description was on a code, test, migration, config or git-commit node.
nodes.rationale: graph-coverage requires a curated node per docs/ markdown file. This node also carries the anchor-cannot-cover-appended-text rule and the suite-green-is-not-semantic-evidence rule.
